name: note_full
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one Perch Sort game UI music EIGHTH NOTE icon. Exactly ONE note: a rounded oval notehead at lower left, one upright stem rising at right of the notehead, and one curved eighth-note flag flowing right from its top. Same original polished rounded 3D cartoon icon family as the supplied white music references, but the interior is GLOSSY WARM GOLD, with a clear continuous DARK BROWN #5A3A22 outline and one small pale highlight near upper left. Simple thick friendly strokes, compact readable silhouette, no face, no rays, no sparkles outside the note, no text, no enclosing badge, no additional notes or sun. Square canvas; complete note centered with generous equal safe margins. Actual transparent alpha background, no cast shadow or colored haze outside the icon. Intended final output 64x64 and to be swapped in place with a dim version sharing exactly this silhouette.
